guards: Every authored numeric DPI and every numeric DPI token across the six nodes must be a positive integer and agree.
An explicitly empty sourceCropFrame is invalid; a nonempty descriptive sourceCropFrame without a DPI token is allowed.
Coordinate-space strings may differ by page/global/focus frame; their numeric DPI declarations must agree.
Only a hash-bound reviewed source-render frame may resolve missing DPI across a separate crop frame.
